# 21
The idea that cities should be built around cars took hold in the middle of the twentieth century. Wide roads and large parking lots replaced neighborhoods where people once walked to shops and schools.
Today many planners are reversing this trend, narrowing streets and adding bike lanes.
윗글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?
① the history of car manufacturing ② why parking lots are expensive to build ③ how city planning is shifting away from cars ④ the dangers of cycling in large cities ⑤ the cost of maintaining wide roads
답: ③
빈칸
1. Wide roads and large parking lots r_____ neighborhoods where people once walked.
넓은 도로와 큰 주차장이 사람들이 걸어 다니던 동네를 대체했다.
답: replaced
본문 O/X
(1) Cities were built around cars from the very beginning of the twentieth century.
답: X
(2) Planners today are adding bike lanes to reduce driving.
답: O

# 22
지문: Some people think that reading is a solitary activity, but book clubs prove otherwise. Members meet to share what they noticed and argue about what the author meant.
2. 윗글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은?
① Reading Alone
② Why Book Clubs Matter
③ The Death of the Novel
정답: ②
어법 O/X
1. Members meets to share what they noticed.
답: X
